checks.details: Requirement 1.1: getInitialSelectResult query added to project router with SelectProjectResult | null return type
Requirement 1.2: Query calls ctx.services.getInitialSelectResult(), clears cache with clearInitialSelectResult() when result is non-null (read-and-clear semantics)
Requirement 1.3: When cache is null (SDD_PROJECT_PATH not set or already consumed), query returns null. The if(result !== null) guard handles this correctly.
Requirement 1.4: ContextServices interface includes getInitialSelectResult and clearInitialSelectResult with correct signatures
Requirement 1.5: createDefaultServices provides default implementations for getInitialSelectResult (returns null) and clearInitialSelectResult (no-op)
Requirement 2.1: useEffect in App.tsx calls vanillaClient.project.getInitialSelectResult.query() after component mount
Requirement 2.2: When query result is not null, applySelectProjectResult(result) is called to apply to store
Requirement 2.3: useRef (initialSelectPulled) prevents duplicate pull calls, ensuring only one execution on mount
Requirement 2.4: try/catch around pull with console.error logging prevents application crash on error
Requirement 3.1: broadcastInitialProjectSelection function removed from main/index.ts. Grep confirms no occurrences in source code (only comment in test file).
Requirement 3.2: ready-to-show handler in index.ts no longer calls broadcastInitialProjectSelection. Handler only shows window.
Requirement 3.3: getInitialSelectResult and clearInitialSelectResult imports removed from index.ts. Only setInitialSelectResult remains (needed for caching).
Requirement 3.4: onProjectSelected Subscription removed from events.ts. Only a comment remains at line 181 noting the removal.
Requirement 3.5: EVENT_NAMES.PROJECT_SELECTED constant removed from eventBus.ts. Only a comment remains at line 29.
Requirement 3.6: trpc.events.onProjectSelected.useSubscription() hook removed from App.tsx. Grep confirms no occurrences.
Requirement 4.1: Redirected to Requirement 1.4 (same content, merged). ContextServices getter/clearer verified.
Requirement 4.2: Redirected to Requirement 1.5 (same content, merged). createDefaultServices defaults verified.
Requirement 4.3: handler.ts imports getInitialSelectResult/clearInitialSelectResult from projectSetup.ts and injects them into mergedOverrides for tRPC context DI.
Requirement 5.1: getInitialSelectResult query tests added with cache-hit (returns result and clears) and cache-miss (returns null) patterns.
Requirement 5.2: Read-and-clear semantics test verifies first call returns result, clearInitialSelectResult is called, and second call returns null.
Requirement 5.3: broadcastInitialProjectSelection test block deleted from index.test.ts. Comment at line 274 confirms intentional removal.
Requirement 5.4: onProjectSelected test removed from events-router.test.ts. Comments at lines 511 and 863 confirm intentional removal. Test list no longer includes onProjectSelected.
